description: This file contains unit tests for the AmqpTarget class within the Eclipse Ditto project, focusing on message destination creation and input validation.

classes.name: AmqpTargetTest
classes.description: Test class for AmqpTarget, verifying equals/hashCode contract, destination creation logic, and input validation.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that AmqpTarget correctly implements equals and hashCode.

methods.name: testCreateQueue
methods.description: Tests creation of a queue destination from a string identifier.

methods.name: testCreateTopic
methods.description: Tests creation of a topic destination from a string identifier with 'topic://' prefix.

methods.name: testNull
methods.description: Ensures that passing null to fromTargetAddress throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: testEmpty
methods.description: Ensures that passing an empty string to fromTargetAddress throws IllegalArgumentException.
